note: Adapted from the original description (in English) with which Constantino (1991) established the genus and the species; the alates, the soldier and the worker all have prose descriptions and measurements, with ratios given. The original calls the alates ALATES. The workers are dimorphic (left mandible index 1.3—1.5).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Of both sexes (no sexual dimorphism seen in the shape and size of the head, pronotum and thorax). Head capsule dark brown, pronotum brown, legs yellowish brown, wing scales brown, postmentum light brown, postclypeus brown, abdominal tergites brown, sternites yellow, wings chestnut brown. Antennal segments 2, 3 and 5 equal in length and longer than segment 4. In lateral view the compound eye touches the lower margin of the head; ocelli oval, close to the compound eye; frontal gland pore about as long as the ocellus. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum concave or obtusely angular. Pronotum with many short hairs and with longer hairs at the margins. Tergites and sternites with many short hairs on the surface and a row of long hairs at the posterior margin. Legs with many fine hairs and scattered setae; the inner margin of the tibiae with many spines slightly thicker than the setae.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, nasus yellowish brown, antennae yellow, pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum yellowish white, sclerites transparent. Antennal segment 3 larger than segment 2, segment 4 larger than segment 3, segment 5 equal to segment 4. Vertex with sparse medium to long setae and many microtrichia. Nasus densely covered with microtrichia, lengthening towards the apex. Tergites and sternites with many short setae on the surface and a row of long setae at the posterior margin. Legs hairy with a few setae; the inner margin of the tibiae with many spines slightly thicker than the setae.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic (left mandible index 1.3—1.5). Head, antennae and legs pale yellow, pronotum yellowish white, sclerites transparent with a slight yellowish tinge. Postclypeus inflated. The chaetotaxy of the abdomen and legs is similar to that of the soldier.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (type colony 5 individuals, mm): hind wing length from the suture 7.90—8.55, hind wing width 2.42—2.66, head length from the tip of the postclypeus 0.92—0.93, lateral head length from the mandible base 0.77—0.86, head width including the compound eyes 1.06—1.10, head height (excluding the postmentum) 0.46—0.49, maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.46, pronotum length 0.84—0.90, hind tibia length 1.32—1.38. Ratios: head length including the compound eyes / hind tibia length 0.79—0.83; pronotum length / hind tibia length 0.37—0.41; pronotum length / width 0.56—0.62; head width including the compound eyes / maximum eye diameter 2.30—2.39. Soldier measurements (type colony 5 individuals): head length from the tip of the postclypeus 0.92—1.00, head length including the nasus 1.54—1.62, head height (excluding the postmentum) 0.54—0.62, head width 0.88—0.96, pronotum width 0.46—0.48, hind tibia length 0.81. Ratios: head length including the nasus / head width 1.69—1.80; head length without the nasus / head width 1.04—1.09; nasus length / head length without the nasus 0.62—0.69. Soldier holotype: Maraa, Amazonas, Brazil, Jaraqui Island, Japura River (01°51′S 65°27′W), primary swamp forest, 6 October 1988 (month 10), collected by R. Constantino (MPEG 2790). Both known colonies were inquilines in arboreal nests built by an undescribed soldierless Apicotermitinae.
